description: List every course in a Canvas account, optionally filtered by `search_term` matching course name or course code. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use `list_sub_accounts` first if you want one sub-account's courses rather than this account's own, and `list_courses` instead for the courses the authenticated user is enrolled in or can access, rather than a full account inventory. Requires an admin role on the account.

search_term.description: Search courses by name or course code

name: list_account_courses
title: List Account Courses
